A '''lightsaber''' was built<ref name="TPM Dictionary" /> by [[32 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|used]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], who served in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was destroyed during a mission sometime before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Gallia had constructed a [[Adi Gallia's second lightsaber/Legends|new lightsaber]] by the invasion's end<ref name="TPM Dictionary" /> in 32 BBY.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The lightsaber was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]] and published in [[1999]].<ref name="TPM Dictionary" />
